content.comment_body: How can we preserve the accumulated values in operating hour counters after modifying the program? These counters are used to record the total runtime of the system and important parts, but it's frustrating to lose all data whenever even a small change is made, such as adjusting a switch setting. We use [product_name] and [product_name] V[version_no]. Is this possible with the newer modular versions?
Refer to the [document] dated 07/2001, chapter 4.4.12. You need [product_name] [version_no] to read MN and OT values from the operating hour counters.
Did you find a solution? Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users indicate that operating hour counters in [company_name] systems reset their accumulated runtime after any program modification, even minor changes. This interferes with reliable equipment runtime tracking, which is essential for maintenance and documentation, highlighting the lack of persistent critical data and causing inconvenience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want operating hour counters to maintain their total runtime values across all program changes, including minor edits, in order to guarantee uninterrupted and precise runtime documentation.
